annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on aligning digitalisation and sustainability from a civil society perspective. It calls for digital taxation, workplace data protection, competition law reform, public data trusts, ecodesign extension and energy-efficient data centres. Robots appear only in passing: cobots under a human-in-command approach, agricultural robots and drones, and autonomous vehicles.
annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Digitalisation and Sustainability – status quo and need for action from a civil society perspective'
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Digitalisation and Sustainability – status quo and need for action from a civil society perspective'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 429
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for digital businesses to pay fair taxes and for a distinctive EU law on workplace data protection building on GDPR
Calls for adjusting competition law to regulate digital platform markets and for public data trusts
Calls for extending the EU ecodesign directive and a digital product pass
Proposes an EU data centre inventory, a top-runner scheme and 100% renewable energy for new data centres
Endorses a 'human-in-command' approach to digitalisation, including cobots, and welcomes agricultural robots and drones
